myproperty.description: MyProperty is one of Hubilai Tech's (HTI) apps, a property-management system (own Postgres 16 database) for managed buildings, rooms, owners (өмчлөгч), tenants (түрээслэгч), contracts, invoices (нэхэмжлэх) and payments; its rooms are mostly commercial, with few dwellings (сууц). People appear only as UUID tokens, and a token joins only to columns in the same token namespace (by default, the same column name).

bronze_ref.myproperty_action.description: Action reference table (domain D6 Workers, tasks & planning); one row per action, referenced by workerAction.actionId. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_action.)

columns.id: Action id; referenced by workerAction.actionId (DDL FK)

bronze_ref.myproperty_archivefile.description: Archived file metadata (domain D9 Integration & misc); file names, paths and URLs are masked, only type/size metadata is kept. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_archivefile.)

bronze_ref.myproperty_bankstatement.description: One row per bank statement line (transaction) of a branch; answers questions about incoming/outgoing bank transactions and how they were applied to contracts and payments (domain D3 Invoicing & payments). (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_bankstatement.)

columns.transactionDate: Bank transaction time; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_bankstatement (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed timestamp and may hold the untransformed value
columns.status: Processing status of the statement line (source default 'NEW')
columns.appliedAt: Timestamp; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_bankstatement (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed timestamp and may hold the untransformed value

bronze_ref.myproperty_bankstatementpayme.description: Allocation of a bank statement line to a payment and contract (DDL FKs to bankStatement, payment and contract). (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_bankstatementpayment.)

columns.isDepositPayment: Whether the allocation is a deposit payment

bronze_ref.myproperty_block.description: One row per block (tower/wing) of a building (domain D1 Buildings, blocks & rooms). (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_block.)

columns.buildingId: Building the block belongs to (FK to building.id)
columns.totalFloors: Number of floors in this block

bronze_ref.myproperty_branch.description: One row per branch, the managing organisation in myproperty (domain D8 Branch & onboarding); holds branch settings such as the system fee. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_branch.)

columns.startDate: Branch start date; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branch (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed timestamp and may hold the untransformed value
columns.feePercent: Branch system fee percentage, e.g. 2 means 2%
columns.feeServiceIds: Selected service IDs used as the fee base; empty means invoice totalAmount

bronze_ref.myproperty_branchbuilding.description: Link between a branch and a building, with the branch's role in that building (DDL FKs to branch and building). (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_branchbuilding.)

columns.role: Branch role in the building, e.g. MAIN_MANAGER, MAINTENANCE_PARTNER, CLEANING_CONTRACTOR

bronze_ref.myproperty_branchbuildingcorp.description: Per branch and building corporate bank connection settings (the credential itself is never copied); domain D8. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_branchbuildingcorporate.)

columns.startSyncDate: Statement sync start date; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branchbuildingcorporate (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed timestamp and may hold the untransformed value

columns.roundDecimal: Decimal places to round invoice totals for this branch
columns.feeFormula: System fee rate as string (e.g. 0.02 for 2%)
columns.startInvoiceDate: Invoicing start date; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branchbuildingpaymentinfo (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed date and may hold the untransformed value

bronze_ref.myproperty_branchinvoice.description: One row per branch invoice for the system fee of a period month (periodMonth = fee calculation period); answers branch fee billing and payment questions. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_branchinvoice.)

columns.periodMonth: YYYY-MM of the fee calculation period
columns.issueDate: Issue date; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branchinvoice (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed date and may hold the untransformed value
columns.dueDate: Due date; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branchinvoice (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed date and may hold the untransformed value
columns.autoPaidAt: When auto-paid; truncated to the hour in silver.myproperty_branchinvoice (time_band rule). This bronze_ref copy is typed timestamp and may hold the untransformed value

bronze_ref.myproperty_branchsupportvar.description: Branch configuration variable table (waived 2026-10-02 as a filter false positive: configuration, not support tickets); variable names are not copied. (bronze_ref copy of a table that also exists as silver.myproperty_branchsupportvar.)

silver.myproperty_ownerhistory.description: Change history of an owner record (no update timestamp in source).

columns.ownerId: UUID token of owner (өмчлөгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'ownerId' namespace
columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_payment.description: One row per payment received from a tenant or owner; answers payment volume, amount and method questions (KPI 14, 16, 18).

columns.paymentDate: Payment date (KPI period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace
columns.ownerId: UUID token of owner (өмчлөгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'ownerId' namespace
columns.method: Payment instrument, e.g. BANK_TRANSFER, QPAY, CREDIT, ADJUSTMENT, DEPOSIT, DISCOUNT, CASH. It is the instrument, not the channel/app
columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_paymentreversehistory.description: Record of a reversed payment (reason text and tenant name are not copied).

columns.paymentDate: Original payment date; truncated to the hour
columns.reversedBy: Who reversed the payment (passed through, not tokenised)
columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace

silver.myproperty_qpayhistory.description: QPay invoice record for an invoice bucket; postData and qpayId are not copied.

columns.stage: Current processing stage of the QPay invoice

silver.myproperty_rentalagreement.description: One row per rental agreement of a room between an owner and a tenant (түрээслэгч) under a management contract; used for tenancy duration and tenant/owner transitions (KPI 20).

columns.managementContractId: Management contract the agreement falls under
columns.startDate: Agreement start date (end must be after start, DDL check); truncated to the hour
columns.endDate: Agreement end date; truncated to the hour
columns.paymentDueDay: Payment due day of month (1-31, DDL check)
columns.terminatedAt: Termination time; truncated to the hour
columns.terminatedBy: Who terminated it (passed through, not tokenised)
columns.roomId: UUID token of room; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'roomId' namespace
columns.ownerId: UUID token of owner (өмчлөгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'ownerId' namespace
columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace
columns.createdBy: UUID token of the person recorded in this column (entity type not documented); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'createdBy' namespace

silver.myproperty_room.description: One row per room/unit in a building (domain D1); answers stock-of-units questions by type, usage and area (KPI 7-12). Mostly commercial: few rows are dwellings.

columns.type: Room type, self-describing codes: PARK = garage (граж), STORAGE = warehouse (агуулах), APARTMENT = dwelling (сууц), OFFICE/SHOP/MARKET/CLINIC/RESTAURANT/HOTEL/BANK/DRUGSTORE = commercial, OTHER = unknown (PARK/STORAGE meaning awaits myproperty confirmation)
columns.hasMeter: Whether the room has a meter
columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace
columns.ownerId: UUID token of owner (өмчлөгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'ownerId' namespace
columns.createdAt: Room record creation time (added 2026-10-09 for KPI growth); truncated to the hour

silver.myproperty_roomhistory.description: Change history of a room (split/merge and other actions); no update timestamp in source.

columns.performedBy: Worker or user ID who performed the action (passed through, not tokenised)
columns.createdAt: When the action was recorded; truncated to the hour
columns.roomId: UUID token of room; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'roomId' namespace

silver.myproperty_roomtype.description: Room type reference table (domain D1); names are not copied.

silver.myproperty_service.description: Billable service reference (domain D4 Services & meters); names are not copied.

silver.myproperty_servicepack.description: Service pack (e.g. parking, cooling, heating pack) per branch and building.

silver.myproperty_servicepackitem.description: Service included in a service pack, with price and quantity (no update timestamp in source).

silver.myproperty_servicepacksynctask.description: Background task that syncs a service pack to contracts.

columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_task.description: One row per task in a branch (domain D6); title and description are not copied.

columns.priority: Priority enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT
columns.status: Status enum: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING, RESOLVED, CLOSED
columns.resolvedAt: Resolution time; truncated to the hour
columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace
columns.createdByWorkerId: UUID token of the worker who created it; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'createdByWorkerId' namespace
columns.assignedWorkerId: UUID token of the assigned worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'assignedWorkerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_taskactivity.description: Activity on a task (comment, status change, assignment, update); note text is not copied.

columns.activityType: Activity type enum: COMMENT, STATUS_CHANGE, ASSIGNMENT, UPDATE
columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_tenant.description: Tenant (түрээслэгч) registry linking to the central user service by userId, one row per tenant; answers tenant counts and growth (KPI 19). Names, register numbers and contacts are not copied.

columns.id: Transform rule says: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace. BUT the lake column is int, i.e. still the raw source id (person-table PK migration not yet applied), so it does NOT join the 'tenantId' token columns of other tables
columns.createdAt: Record creation time (KPI 19 period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Record last update time; truncated to the hour
columns.userId: UUID token of user in the central User Service (global user, unique by phone); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'userId' namespace

silver.myproperty_tenantbalance.description: Current credit balance of a tenant.

columns.balance: Positive balance = available credit; never negative
columns.tenant_id: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenant_id' namespace

silver.myproperty_tenantbalancehistory.description: Movement history of a tenant's credit balance (no update timestamp in source).

columns.payment_id: Payment; null when balance is consumed automatically without a payment record
columns.delta: Positive = credit added, negative = credit consumed
columns.tenant_id: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenant_id' namespace

silver.myproperty_tenanthistory.description: Change history of a tenant record (no update timestamp in source).

columns.tenantId: UUID token of tenant (түрээслэгч); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'tenantId' namespace
columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_vat.description: VAT (НӨАТ) receipt record for a payment; request/QR JSON is not copied.

silver.myproperty_worker.description: Worker account of the myproperty app (login, system role, position), one row per worker; names, contacts and the password hash are not copied.

columns.id: Worker id (passed through as a raw id; FK target of worker columns in the DDL)
columns.isActive: Whether the worker account is active or suspended
columns.lastLoginAt: Last login time; truncated to the hour

silver.myproperty_workeraction.description: Link between a worker and an action (both foreign keys in the DDL).

columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_workerbuilding.description: Link between a worker and a building (DDL FKs to worker and building).

columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace

silver.myproperty_workerlog.description: Log of changes to a worker (DDL FKs workerId and updatedBy -> worker).

columns.workerId: UUID token of worker; not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'workerId' namespace
columns.updatedBy: UUID token of worker (FK to worker in the source DDL); not a real ID. Joins only to other token columns in the 'updatedBy' namespace
